abstract: INTRODUCTION: Disorders of sexual development (DSD) comprise a group of congenital conditions, occurring in approximately 1 in 4,500 to 5,500 newborns. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Over a 3-year period, seven cases presented with ambiguous genitalia, primary amenorrhea, and abdominal masses and were admitted to our hospital's General Surgery and Gynaecology wards. Radiological, cytogenetics, and hormonal evaluation was done, followed by surgical excision and histopathological examination of the gonads. The study was conducted with proper written informed consent from parents and received approval from the Institutional Ethics Committee. RESULTS: Out of four cases diagnosed with mixed gonadal dysgenesis (MGD), one had dysgerminoma, one had both dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma, and another had bilateral gonadoblastoma. Three other cases were diagnosed as ovo-testicular DSD. We experienced varied presentations of dysgenetic gonads in DSD - ovotestis to streak gonad and dysgenetic testis. CONCLUSION: Early diagnosis and categorization of disorders of sex development (DSD) are crucial to prevent adverse outcomes and ensure optimal management.
abstract_ja: はじめに：性分化疾患（DSD）は、約4,500〜5,500人に1人の新生児に生じる先天性疾患群である。材料と方法：3年間で7例が曖昧な外陰部、原発無月経、腹部腫瘤を主訴に当院の一般外科および婦人科病棟に入院した。放射線学的検査、細胞遺伝学的検査、ホルモン評価を行い、その後、性腺の外科的切除と病理組織学的検査を行った。本研究は、両親からのインフォームド・コンセントを得て実施し、施設倫理委員会の承認を受けた。結果：混合性性腺異形成（MGD）と診断された4例のうち、1例はディスジャーミノーマ、1例はディスジャーミノーマと性腺芽腫の両方、別の1例は両側性の性腺芽腫であった。他の3例は卵精巣性DSDと診断された。DSDにおける異形成性性腺は、卵精巣から条線状性腺、異形成精巣まで多様な形態を示した。結論：DSDの早期診断と分類は、不良な転帰を防ぎ、最適な管理を確実に行うために極めて重要である。
